data.sentenceEn: Otherwise, all data that was stored on its hard drive will be forever lost.
data.translationZh: 否则，其硬盘上存储的所有数据都将永久丢失。
data.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第2句

data.sentenceEn: According to market data enterprises, Americans spend nearly 10 billion dollars a year on self-help and personal-organization products.
data.translationZh: 根据市场数据企业统计，美国人每年在自助和个人组织类产品上的花费近100亿美元。
data.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

data.sentenceEn: Soon when you log into a restaurant app, it will be able to use your data and purchasing history to recommend dishes to you — factoring in everything from the weather to, if you are ordering at a screen that can read your face, your mood.
data.translationZh: 不久之后，当你登录餐厅应用时，系统将能利用你的个人数据和购买历史为你推荐菜肴——它会综合考虑从天气状况到你当前心情的所有因素，如果你是在一个具备面部识别功能的屏幕前下单，系统甚至能读懂你的情绪。

data.sentenceEn: Combined with machine learning of anticipated order volumes and the minute-by-minute cooking data generated by systems such as QSR, that robot fleet could deliver almost instantly.
data.translationZh: 结合对预期订单量的机器学习，以及由 QSR 等系统生成的每分钟烹饪数据，该机器人机群几乎可以实现即时交付。

data.sentenceEn: When people are thinking of an endeavor, they should dig out reliable data that tells them how likely they are to succeed.
data.translationZh: 当人们考虑从事某项事业时，应当挖掘可靠的数据，以了解成功的可能性。

data.sentenceEn: It drew its conclusion without any contrastive data from other experiments.
data.translationZh: 它在没有任何其他实验对比数据的情况下得出了结论。

decade.sentenceEn: For almost a decade , I told everyone I encountered that they should do the same.
decade.translationZh: 近十年来，我告诉遇到的每一个人，他们也应该这样做。
decade.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

decade.sentenceEn: During that decade , the gender pay gap closed by about one percentage point a year.
decade.translationZh: 在那十年间，性别薪酬差距每年缩小约1个百分点。
decade.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

decade.sentenceEn: On the contrary, decades of research shows that female candidates raise as much money and win as often as male politicians with similar credentials.
decade.translationZh: 相反，数十年的研究表明，在资历相似的情况下，女性候选人募集的资金与男性政客相当，当选率也不相上下。
decade.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

decade.sentenceEn: More than five decades later, our society is still struggling to separate truth from fantasy, fact from fiction.
decade.translationZh: 五十多年后的今天，我们的社会仍在努力区分真相与幻想、事实与虚构。
decade.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

decade.sentenceEn: What did the author advise people do for almost a decade ?
decade.translationZh: 近十年来，作者建议人们做什么？

decade.sentenceEn: It has increased its wind and solar power generation four times over the last two decades .
decade.translationZh: 在过去二十年中，其风能和太阳能发电量增长了四倍。

design.sentenceEn: Trying to recreate their designs would have been futile.
design.translationZh: 试图重现他们的设计是徒劳的。
design.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

design.sentenceEn: An effective simulation can be better than experience as a learning tool because it accelerates time, compresses space, and unlike reality, is specifically designed to maximize participant learning.
design.translationZh: 作为一种学习工具，有效的模拟可能比实际经验更优越，因为它能加速时间、压缩空间，而且与现实不同，模拟是专门为最大限度提升参与者学习效果而设计的。
design.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

design.sentenceEn: It is designed for domestic use, but a commercial version is planned that opens up the possibility of restaurant kitchens automating even highly technically challenging tasks.
design.translationZh: 该产品专为家庭使用而设计，但其计划推出的商业版本将使餐厅厨房实现极具技术挑战的任务自动化成为可能。

design.sentenceEn: "Automation systems designed to make the process more idiot-proof are trying to bridge that gap," says Stefan Chomka, the editor of Restaurant magazine.
design.translationZh: 《餐厅》杂志编辑斯特凡·乔姆卡表示：“旨在使流程更加简单易用、防止误操作的自动化系统，正试图填补这一空白。”

design.sentenceEn: How do altered menu designs affect frequent eaters of vegetarian food?
design.translationZh: 菜单设计的改变如何影响素食常客？

design.sentenceEn: Its different shelves are designed for different purposes.
design.translationZh: 它的不同架子有不同的设计用途。

demand.sentenceEn: Demand for meat is rising in developing and emerging economies, especially in the Middle East, North Africa and Southeast Asia.
demand.translationZh: 发展中经济体和新兴经济体对肉类的需求正在上升，特别是在中东、北非和东南亚地区。

demand.sentenceEn: Climate change demands urgent attention, and the livestock industry has a large overall environmental footprint that affects air, water and land.
demand.translationZh: 气候变化亟需关注，而畜牧业的整体环境足迹巨大，影响着空气、水和土地。

demand.sentenceEn: To demand that governments set the 'happiness' of citizens as their highest priority is to demand that they view citizens as ends in themselves.
demand.translationZh: 要求政府将公民的“幸福”作为最高优先事项，就是要求政府将公民本身视为目的。
demand.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

demand.sentenceEn: "Self-order screens mean more demand for people front-of-house. Last year, we recruited 1,000 new managers," says McDonald's COO, Jason Clark.
demand.translationZh: 麦当劳首席运营官杰森·克拉克表示：“自助点餐机的普及意味着前厅需要更多的人手。去年，我们新招募了1000名经理。”

demand.sentenceEn: What did the federal government do to meet the increasing demand for the postal service in the West?
demand.translationZh: 联邦政府做了什么来满足西部对邮政服务日益增长的需求？

demand.sentenceEn: They are all in increasingly great demand .
demand.translationZh: 它们的需求量都越来越大。

decline.sentenceEn: Real wages have not kept pace with productivity, driving economic inequality and a decline in labor's share of income.
decline.translationZh: 实际工资未能跟上生产率增长的步伐，这加剧了经济不平等，并导致劳动收入占比下降。
decline.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

decline.sentenceEn: The decline of civil discourse stems in part from the fact that it is so easy for people to watch news about, buy products from, and engage—in both the virtual and real worlds—only with those of similar backgrounds and ideologies.
decline.translationZh: 公民话语的衰落，部分源于人们可以轻易地只关注与自己背景和意识形态相似者的新闻、购买他们的产品，并在虚拟和现实世界中仅与这类人互动。

decline.sentenceEn: According to the FAO's statistical database, total direct greenhouse gas emissions from U.S. livestock have declined by 11.3 percent since 1961, while production of livestock meat has more than doubled.
decline.translationZh: 根据联合国粮农组织的统计数据库，自1961年以来，美国畜牧业的直接温室气体排放总量下降了11.3%，而畜禽肉类产量却增长了一倍以上。

decline.sentenceEn: And that second group of people is becoming the majority as the number of Americans who enjoy cooking is declining .
decline.translationZh: 随着喜欢做饭的美国人数量不断减少，这第二类人群正逐渐成为大多数。
decline.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

decline.sentenceEn: New research looked at people who increased their exercise levels after their 40s beyond levels they had when they were younger and those individuals showed declines in their risk of early mortality which were similar to those of people who exercised consistently throughout their lives.
decline.translationZh: 最新研究显示，在40岁后增加锻炼强度、甚至超过年轻时期水平的人群，其早逝风险的降幅与终身坚持锻炼的人群相似。
decline.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

decline.sentenceEn: American motherhood has actually been on the decline .
decline.translationZh: 美国的母亲角色实际上一直在减少。

diet.sentenceEn: But according to one recent study, even if Americans eliminated all animal protein from their diets , they would reduce U.S. greenhouse gas emissions by only 2.6 percent.
diet.translationZh: 但根据最近的一项研究，即使美国人从饮食中完全去除所有动物蛋白，他们也只能减少美国2.6%的温室气体排放。

diet.sentenceEn: Studies have linked consumption of ultra-processed foods—which are packed high in salt, sugar, and fat—with weight gain and an increased risk of chronic diseases, even after adjusting for the amount of salt, sugar, and fat in the diet .
diet.translationZh: 研究表明，即使在调整了饮食中盐、糖和脂肪的摄入量后，食用超加工食品——这类食品通常富含盐、糖和脂肪——仍与体重增加和慢性疾病风险升高有关。
diet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

diet.sentenceEn: Remember, overcoming the behavioral inertia that prevents us from implementing new changes, like eating a healthy diet or exercising, can benefit us in the long run and can improve our physical and mental health.
diet.translationZh: 记住，克服阻碍我们实施新改变的行为惯性，比如健康饮食或锻炼身体，从长远来看对我们有益，并且能改善我们的身心健康。

diet.sentenceEn: Basically, it allows me to have a more varied diet with a far wider assortment of nutrients, because it's not only fruit in my morning juices you see.
diet.translationZh: 基本上，它让我的饮食更加多样化，能摄入的营养种类也丰富得多，因为你知道，我的晨间果汁里可不仅仅只有水果。
diet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第2句

diet.sentenceEn: But the rising interest in forgotten foods in some quarters is overtaken by the global spread of Western-style diets heavy in sugar, fat and processed foods in others.
diet.translationZh: 然而，某些群体对被遗忘食物的兴趣日益浓厚，却被全球范围内另一种趋势所超越——西式饮食的普及，这类饮食富含糖、脂肪和加工食品。

diet.sentenceEn: Conventional wisdom about diet is seldom supported by science.
diet.translationZh: 关于饮食的传统观念很少得到科学的支持。

despite.sentenceEn: Despite the rising costs of concert and theater tickets, public library events (including concerts, author visits, and gallery displays) are often offered free of charge, enabling people of any income level to attend.
despite.translationZh: 尽管音乐会和戏剧门票价格不断上涨，但公共图书馆活动（包括音乐会、作家见面会和画廊展览）往往免费提供，使各收入水平的人都能参与。

despite.sentenceEn: Take a close look next time you're in Boston, and here are some of the things you'll probably see: people smoking in the subway stations despite the frequent reminders not to do so; pedestrians walking when the crosswalk lights say not to do so, ignoring the cars; car drivers speeding, making a loud noise with the horn and occasionally cursing at each other.
despite.translationZh: 下次你在波士顿时仔细观察，可能会发现这些现象：人们无视频繁的警示在地铁站吸烟；行人不顾交通信号灯和车辆，闯红灯过马路；汽车司机超速行驶，按喇叭制造噪音，偶尔还会互相咒骂。
despite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

despite.sentenceEn: In the U.S., full time employees work an average of 8.72 hours per day despite productivity increases.
despite.translationZh: 在美国，尽管生产力有所提高，全职员工平均每天仍工作8.72小时。
despite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

despite.sentenceEn: The study revealed that 80% of participating dogs successfully followed pointing gestures to a specific location despite having never received prior training.
despite.translationZh: 研究显示，80%参与实验的狗尽管从未接受过相关训练，仍能成功跟随指向手势找到特定位置。
despite.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

despite.sentenceEn: What a traffic light means is almost the same everywhere despite some variations.
despite.translationZh: 尽管存在一些细微差异，但交通信号灯的含义在世界各地几乎都是一样的。

despite.sentenceEn: It is closely coordinated despite seeming confusion.
despite.translationZh: 尽管看似混乱，但它的协调性很强。

digital.sentenceEn: Archives preserve historic artifacts, oral histories, digital history projects, and scholarly writings relevant to the community, including minority groups.
digital.translationZh: 档案馆保存与社区相关的历史文物、口述历史、数字历史项目和学术著作，包括少数群体的相关资料。

digital.sentenceEn: But in an increasingly digital world, we see the role of libraries as community and cultural centers at times undervalued.
digital.translationZh: 但在日益数字化的世界中，我们发现图书馆作为社区和文化中心的作用有时被低估了。

digital.sentenceEn: "For the first time in a few hundred years, digital is allowing us to create new versions of restaurants."
digital.translationZh: 几百年来，数字化正首次让我们能够创造出新形态的餐厅。

digital.sentenceEn: Have we become so subtly conditioned by digital technology that we don't see what's been happening to us?
digital.translationZh: 我们是否已经在数字技术的潜移默化影响下，变得无法察觉自身正在经历的变化？
digital.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

digital.sentenceEn: Digital technology makes it possible for businesses to innovate restaurant models.
digital.translationZh: 数字技术使企业能够创新餐饮模式。

digital.sentenceEn: A large part of digital tech is now making use of humans to meet its own ends.
digital.translationZh: 很大一部分数字技术现在正利用人类来实现其自身目的。

due.sentenceEn: It matters less as a cause of lower student achievement due to missed instruction.
due.translationZh: 作为因教学缺失导致学生成绩下降的原因，它的重要性相对较低。
due.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第3句

due.sentenceEn: I also found that promoting the pursuit of one's passion helps perpetuate social inequalities due to the fact that not everyone has the same economic resources to allow them to pursue their passion with ease.
due.translationZh: 我还发现，宣扬追求个人热情会加剧社会不平等，因为并非每个人都拥有同样的经济资源，能够轻松追求自己的热爱。
due.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

due.sentenceEn: If you strongly identify as not being a quitter, you can end up staying stuck in a course of action due to your narrow and rigid self-concept.
due.translationZh: 如果你强烈地认为自己是一个绝不轻言放弃的人，这种狭隘且僵化的自我认同可能会让你陷入某种行动路径中无法自拔。

due.sentenceEn: W: The comet will be almost exactly due north, at 60 degrees above the equator.
due.translationZh: 女士：这颗彗星将几乎正好位于正北方向，在赤道上方60度处。
due.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

due.sentenceEn: Over the coming decade, many jobs in traditional restaurants will disappear due to robot delivery.
due.translationZh: 未来十年，由于机器人送餐的普及，传统餐厅的许多岗位将会消失。

due.sentenceEn: They are likely to cause a decrease in students' academic achievements due to missed instruction.
due.translationZh: 由于错过了教学内容，它们很可能导致学生学业成绩下降。

determine.sentenceEn: Only with a richer theory of the self and a larger test battery will we be able to determine all of the various levels of self-awareness, including where exactly fish fit in.
determine.translationZh: 只有拥有更完善的自我理论和更全面的测试手段，我们才能确定自我意识的所有不同层级，并弄清楚鱼类究竟处于其中的什么位置。
determine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

determine.sentenceEn: The Turing test was conceived, you may recall, as a way of enabling humans to determine whether a machine could respond in such a way that one couldn't tell whether it was a human or a robot.
determine.translationZh: 你可能还记得，图灵测试的构思初衷是让人们能够判断：一台机器的反应是否已经达到了让人无法分辨其究竟是人类还是机器人的程度。
determine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

determine.sentenceEn: Since I was a new user, the website decided that it needed to check I wasn't a robot and so set me a Captcha test to determine whether the user is a person or a machine.
determine.translationZh: 由于我是新用户，该网站决定需要检查我是否为机器人，因此安排了一项验证码测试，以判定用户是真人还是机器。
determine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

determine.sentenceEn: What's more, since actions strongly determine thoughts and feelings, when a person consistently acts sarcastically it may only serve to heighten their underlying hostility and insecurity.
determine.translationZh: 更重要的是，由于行为强烈影响思想和感受，当一个人持续以讽刺的方式行事时，这只会加剧其内心深处的敌意和不安全感。
determine.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

determine.sentenceEn: It is hard to determine whether people who are free from dementia tend to have more social activities, or more social activities keep people away from dementia.
determine.translationZh: 很难确定是没有患痴呆症的人往往会有更多的社交活动，还是更多的社交活动能让人们远离痴呆症。

determine.sentenceEn: It invariably determines how food sells.
determine.translationZh: 它始终决定着食品的销售情况。

device.sentenceEn: The devices most people use are a perpetual diversion from the present moment.
device.translationZh: 大多数人使用的设备总是让人分心，无法专注于当下。
device.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

device.sentenceEn: While many young children are now growing up with digital media exposure through mobile devices like tablets and phones, television remains a dominant screen activity, accounting for 72% of all screen time.
device.translationZh: 尽管现在许多幼儿通过平板电脑和手机等移动设备接触数字媒体长大，但电视仍是主要的屏幕活动，占所有屏幕时间的72%。
device.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

device.sentenceEn: If a device can be repaired, then its life can be extended, saving consumers money and the planet the burden of so many trashed gadgets.
device.translationZh: 如果设备可以维修，那么它的使用寿命就能延长，既为消费者省钱，也为地球减轻了处理大量废弃电子产品的负担。
device.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

device.sentenceEn: They gather "data exhaust" left by employees' email and instant messaging apps, and use name badges equipped with radio-frequency identification devices and microphones.
device.translationZh: 他们收集员工通过电子邮件和即时通讯应用产生的“数据废气”，并使用配备了射频识别装置和麦克风的姓名徽章。
device.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

device.sentenceEn: In response to past critics, Twenge and her co-researchers stress they are not trying to prove that the use of digital devices reduces young people's wellbeing.
device.translationZh: 针对以往的批评，特文格及其共同研究者强调，他们并非试图证明数字设备的使用会降低年轻人的幸福感。

device.sentenceEn: They provide a necessary device for a digital detox.
device.translationZh: 它们为数字戒瘾提供了必要的工具

debate.sentenceEn: From disputes over the climate change to debates about how slavery is taught, America is at a crossroads.
debate.translationZh: 从气候变化的争议到奴隶制教育方式的辩论，美国正处于十字路口。
debate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

debate.sentenceEn: The debate centers around a system developed by Monteiro and colleagues that classifies foods by their degree of industrial processing, ranging from unprocessed to ultra-processed.
debate.translationZh: 这场争论围绕着由Monteiro及其同事开发的一个系统展开，该系统根据食品的工业加工程度对其进行分类，范围从非加工食品到超加工食品。
debate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

debate.sentenceEn: The authors, Carlos Monteiro of the University of São Paulo and Arne Astrup of Novo Nordisk Foundation, will discuss the issue in a live virtual debate August 14th during NUTRITION 2024 LIVE ONLINE.
debate.translationZh: 作者——圣保罗大学的卡洛斯·蒙泰罗和诺和诺德基金会的阿恩·阿斯特鲁普，将在8月14日的2024年营养学年会（线上直播）期间，就这一问题展开一场线上直播辩论。
debate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

debate.sentenceEn: While there is strong scientific consensus around most existing guidelines, one question has recently stirred debate : should consumers be warned to avoid ultra-processed foods?
debate.translationZh: 虽然科学界对大多数现有指南有着强烈共识，但最近有一个问题引发了争议：是否应该警告消费者避免超加工食品？
debate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

debate.sentenceEn: What question is said to have recently stirred debate ?
debate.translationZh: 据说最近引发争论的问题是什么？

debate.sentenceEn: We have poor awareness of how many controversial issues are being debated .
debate.translationZh: 我们对正在辩论的有多少争议性问题缺乏了解。

damage.sentenceEn: Tardigrades, however, have evolved special strategies for dealing with these kinds of damage .
damage.translationZh: 然而，缓步动物进化出了应对这类损伤的特殊策略。
damage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

damage.sentenceEn: It does damage to cells in some of the same ways that freezing, vacuum and radiation do.
damage.translationZh: 它对细胞造成损害的方式，在某些方面与冷冻、真空和辐射造成损害的方式相同。
damage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

damage.sentenceEn: Mishandled refers to bags that have been delayed, lost, stolen or damaged .
damage.translationZh: 不当处理行李是指在运输过程中发生的延误、丢失、被盗或损毁的情况。

declare.sentenceEn: After the blaze was declared completely extinguished, 15 hours after it started, the junior interior minister, Laurent Nunez, said the structure had been saved but remained vulnerable.
declare.translationZh: 在大火开始15小时后被宣布完全扑灭后，法国内政部副部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，建筑主体已被挽救，但仍处于脆弱状态。

declare.sentenceEn: Why did SAG-AFTRA declare a strike against some video game publishers?
declare.translationZh: 为什么美国演员工会-美国电视与广播艺术家联合会(SAG-AFTRA)会宣布对部分电子游戏发行商发起罢工？

declare.sentenceEn: The state government declared it the official Arbor Day.
declare.translationZh: 州政府将这一天定为官方的植树节。

deposit.sentenceEn: The first month's rent and a deposit are mandatory on signing the contract.
deposit.translationZh: 签订合同时需支付首月租金和押金，这是必须的。
deposit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

deposit.sentenceEn: The main reasons for thinking otherwise are the scattered bones and the thickness of the deposit .
deposit.translationZh: 认为情况并非如此的主要原因是这些分散的骨骼以及沉积物的厚度。
deposit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

deposit.sentenceEn: In other deposits where the animals were thought to have died together, the skeletons were usually complete and often all the bones were in their proper places.
deposit.translationZh: 在其他被认为是动物集体死亡的遗址中，骨骼通常是完整的，而且往往所有骨头都处于其应有的位置。
deposit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

deposit.sentenceEn: This dinosaur pit is the largest and best preserved deposit of dinosaurs known today.
deposit.translationZh: 这个恐龙坑是目前已知最大、保存最完好的恐龙化石遗址。
deposit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

deposit.sentenceEn: What did the woman do to persuade the man to deposit in her bank?
deposit.translationZh: 这位女士做了什么来劝说男士在她的银行存款？

deposit.sentenceEn: Pay the first month's rent and a deposit .

devote.sentenceEn: Though a significant body of research has examined dog cognition previously, the authors of this new study found little to warrant the volume of work that has been devoted to the topic.
devote.translationZh: 尽管此前已有大量研究探讨过狗的认知能力，但这项新研究的作者发现，这些研究投入的工作量与研究价值并不相称。
devote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

devote.sentenceEn: You might be surprised to learn that the benefits of friendships extend beyond people's social life and into their work, which is interesting when considering the extent to which people sacrifice friendships, or at least the time they spend with friends, because of the extended hours they're devoting to work.
devote.translationZh: 你可能会惊讶地发现，友谊的益处不仅限于人们的社交生活，还延伸到了工作领域。考虑到人们因为投入工作的时间延长而牺牲友谊，或者至少是牺牲与朋友相处的时间，这一点就显得尤为有趣。
devote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

devote.sentenceEn: Zachary Silver, an American researcher, believes the authors of the new study overstated the idea that an excessive amount of research has been devoted to dogs, as the field of dog cognition is young, and there is much to be learned about how dogs think.
devote.translationZh: 美国研究员扎卡里·西尔弗认为，这项新研究的作者夸大了“过多研究都投入到狗身上”这一观点，因为狗认知研究领域尚处于起步阶段，关于狗的思维方式还有很多有待探索。
devote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

devote.sentenceEn: Now, however, with heightened intensity, considerable energy is devoted to competing for position and a definite undercurrent of competition permeates the relationship.
devote.translationZh: 然而现在，随着（这种竞争意识的）强度增加，他们投入了大量精力去争夺地位，一种明显的竞争暗流渗透在他们的关系中。
devote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

devote.sentenceEn: What do most males devote much of their energy to during adolescence?
devote.translationZh: 青春期的大多数男性会将大量精力投入到什么事情上？

devote.sentenceEn: She can devote all her life to pursuing her passion.
devote.translationZh: 她可以倾尽一生去追求自己热爱的事业。

depict.sentenceEn: Previous studies of young children have suggested that electronic books, which incorporate extra features such as dictionaries and images that depict story events, may have advantages over print.
depict.translationZh: 针对幼儿的既往研究表明，电子书整合了词典、故事场景配图等额外功能，可能比纸质书更具优势。
depict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

depict.sentenceEn: When Defoe depicted Robinson Crusoe making thanksgiving a daily part of his island life, he was anticipating findings in social science and medicine that would not appear for hundreds of years.
depict.translationZh: 当笛福描绘鲁滨逊·克鲁索将感恩作为其荒岛生活的日常部分时，他其实预见了数百年后才会出现的社会科学和医学发现。

depict.sentenceEn: Stress is often depicted as negative, but research shows that moderate amounts of it can be beneficial for your brain and your body.
depict.translationZh: 压力常被描绘成负面的，但研究表明适量的压力对大脑和身体都有益处。
depict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

depict.sentenceEn: The researchers believe that other companies could bolster sales of healthy foods with similar ads, depicting their products as attractive and a source of pleasure.
depict.translationZh: 研究人员认为，其他公司也可以通过类似的广告来促进健康食品的销售，将其产品描绘成具有吸引力且能带来愉悦体验的来源。
depict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第5句

depict.sentenceEn: W: I love how she depicts the barren landscape.
depict.translationZh: 我喜欢她对这片荒芜 landscape 的描绘。
depict.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

depict.sentenceEn: It depicts the beauty of desolation.

desert.sentenceEn: As federal subsidies and land grants tempted people into the deserts and plains, the post kept them connected.
desert.translationZh: 当联邦补贴和土地授予吸引人们前往沙漠和平原地区时，邮政服务让他们与外界保持着联系。
desert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句
文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

desert.sentenceEn: Like all deserts , though, if you are patient, you will be rewarded, as they often reveal their secrets slowly.
desert.translationZh: 不过，如同所有沙漠一样，只要你有耐心，就一定会有所收获，因为它们总是会慢慢揭开自己的神秘面纱。
desert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

desert.sentenceEn: The desert , however, is overflowing with life, mystery, and magic.
desert.translationZh: 然而，这片沙漠却充满了生命、神秘与魔力。
desert.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

desert.sentenceEn: There are a couple of plants tough and adaptable enough to survive on bare rocky hills and in deserts .
desert.translationZh: 有几种植物非常坚韧且适应性强，能够在光秃秃的岩石山丘和沙漠中生存。

desert.sentenceEn: It kept people in the deserts and plains connected.
desert.translationZh: 邮政服务让生活在沙漠和平原地区的人们保持着联系。

deserve.sentenceEn: A snob is anyone who takes a relatively small part of us and uses it to come to a rigid conclusion about how much of their attention we deserve .
deserve.translationZh: 势利小人就是那种只取我们身上相对微不足道的某一点，就武断地判定我们值得他们投入多少关注的人。
deserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

deserve.sentenceEn: But our children and our grandchildren deserve better.
deserve.translationZh: 但我们的子孙后代应该过上更好的生活。
deserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

deserve.sentenceEn: They really deserve to be complimented for it.
deserve.translationZh: 他们确实值得为此受到称赞。
deserve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第6句

deserve.sentenceEn: Instead of experiencing a benefaction(善行) as a good turn, people sometimes regard it as a mere payment of what they are owed, for which no one deserves any moral credit.
deserve.translationZh: 人们有时不把善行视为一种善举，而是将其看作对方仅仅在偿还所欠自己的东西，因此认为这种行为不值得任何道德上的赞扬。

deserve.sentenceEn: Pritchett concedes that his find deserves careful excavation and preservation.
deserve.translationZh: 普里切特承认，他的发现值得进行仔细的发掘和保护。

deserve.sentenceEn: They do not think they benefit as much as they deserve .
deserve.translationZh: 他们认为自己得到的利益不如应得的多。

destruction.sentenceEn: Advocates for the protection of the natural environment from destruction or pollution urge the public to eat less meat.
destruction.translationZh: 倡导保护自然环境免受破坏或污染的人士呼吁公众减少肉类 consumption。

destruction.sentenceEn: A recent landmark study identified a 75% fall in insect populations between 1989 and 2016, with pesticide use thought to be to blame along with the destruction of wild areas for development.
destruction.translationZh: 近期一项具有里程碑意义的研究发现，1989年至2016年间昆虫数量下降了75%。人们认为，杀虫剂的使用以及为开发而破坏野生区域是造成这一现象的主要原因。
destruction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

destruction.sentenceEn: In the long view, the human relationship with forests has been one of brutal destruction , but even it carries elements of slow hope.
destruction.translationZh: 从长远来看，人类与森林的关系一直是残酷的破坏，但即便如此，其中也蕴含着缓慢的希望。

destruction.sentenceEn: I was still trying to cope with the death, destruction and evil I had seen in Vietnam.
destruction.translationZh: 我仍在努力应对在越南目睹的死亡、毁灭与邪恶。
destruction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

destruction.sentenceEn: One luxury brand employee quit her job because she simply couldn't bear to see the destruction of unsold products.
destruction.translationZh: 一位奢侈品牌员工辞去了工作，因为她实在无法忍受目睹未售出产品被销毁。

destruction.sentenceEn: Super-intelligence may cause its own destruction .
destruction.translationZh: 超级智能可能会导致人类自身的毁灭。

dispute.sentenceEn: Someone may employ me to break the deadlock and resolve the dispute .
dispute.translationZh: 也许会有人聘请我来打破僵局，解决争端。
dispute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

dispute.sentenceEn: Most of my work involves mediating land disputes .
dispute.translationZh: 我的大部分工作涉及调解土地纠纷。
dispute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

dispute.sentenceEn: From disputes over the climate change to debates about how slavery is taught, America is at a crossroads.
dispute.translationZh: 从气候变化的争议到奴隶制教育方式的辩论，美国正处于十字路口。
dispute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

dispute.sentenceEn: One thing I've learned in a quarter-century of management is that there are ample gray areas in human behavior, and that there may not always be clear right-or-wrong solutions to employee disputes .
dispute.translationZh: 在二十五年的管理生涯中，我学到的一点是，人的行为存在大量的灰色地带，而员工之间的纠纷也并不总是有非黑即白的解决方案。
dispute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

dispute.sentenceEn: What does the speaker definitely recall about the dispute mentioned as an example?
dispute.translationZh: 关于作为例子提到的那场争论，说话者肯定记得的是什么？

dispute.sentenceEn: Courts are intended for fixing major legal disputes .
dispute.translationZh: 法庭旨在解决重大法律纠纷。

dominate.sentenceEn: Reality shows have come to dominate US television over the past 20 years, notes Eunji Kim from Vanderbilt University.
dominate.translationZh: 范德堡大学的金恩智指出，在过去20年里，真人秀节目已逐渐主导美国电视市场。
dominate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

dominate.sentenceEn: Ever since the "green revolution" of the 1960s, high-yielding crops have dominated modern agriculture.
dominate.translationZh: 自20世纪60年代的"绿色革命"以来，高产作物一直主导着现代农业。

dominate.sentenceEn: These can check how much time you spend talking, your volume and tone of voice, even if you do not dominate conversations.
dominate.translationZh: 这些设备可以监测你说话的时长、音量和语调，即使你并非谈话的主导者。
dominate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

dominate.sentenceEn: Today, the household cleaning products industry is worth billions of dollars a year and is dominated by large global companies.
dominate.translationZh: 如今，家用清洁用品行业年产值达数十亿美元，由大型跨国公司主导。
dominate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

dominate.sentenceEn: With competition from many countries, Antarctica is no longer dominated by the traditional white nations.
dominate.translationZh: 随着众多国家的竞争，南极洲不再由传统白人国家主导。

dominate.sentenceEn: It was once dominated by dinosaurs.
dominate.translationZh: 这里曾一度被恐龙主宰。

deem.sentenceEn: It isn't ground-breaking to say workers feel fatigued after a meeting, but only in recent decades have scientists deemed the condition worthy of further investigation.
deem.translationZh: 说员工开会后感到疲劳并非什么惊天动地的发现，但直到最近几十年，科学家们才认为这种情况值得进一步研究。

deem.sentenceEn: Honesty was deemed to be more of a sin than a virtue, since it made people feel uncomfortable, or at least it made the most powerful folks feel uncomfortable.
deem.translationZh: 诚实被视为一种罪过而非美德，因为它让人感到不舒服，或者至少让那些最有权势的人感到不舒服。
deem.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

deem.sentenceEn: Sure, it affects people's personal lives to what could be deemed an unhealthy extent, because leisure activities are often seen as a part of life that must be sacrificed to manage work and family demands.
deem.translationZh: 当然，这种心态会对人们的个人生活产生可能被视为不健康的影响，因为休闲活动常常被看作是为了应付工作和家庭需求而必须牺牲的一部分生活。
deem.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

deem.sentenceEn: Those deemed to be most destructive were odd people—those without drive, those who allow personal problems into the workplace, and those with an unpleasant temperament or personality in general.
deem.translationZh: 那些被认为最具破坏力的是一类古怪的人——缺乏干劲的人、将个人问题带入工作场所的人，以及总体上性情或个性令人不快的人。
deem.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

deem.sentenceEn: What kind of people do snobs deem worth respect and esteem?
deem.translationZh: 势利眼认为什么样的人值得尊重和敬重？

deem.sentenceEn: It is not deemed exotic by Proper Bostonians.
deem.translationZh: 在正宗波士顿人眼中，这并不算是什么新奇事物。

definitely.sentenceEn: I think he definitely looked more mature than Rachel.
definitely.translationZh: 我觉得他看起来确实比瑞秋成熟得多。
definitely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

definitely.sentenceEn: Those little bins on the inside of refrigerator doors are convenient, but they don't maintain a consistent temperature, so definitely refrain from putting perishable foods in there.
definitely.translationZh: 冰箱门内侧的那些小储物格虽然方便，但温度不稳定，所以千万不要把易腐食品放在那里。
definitely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

definitely.sentenceEn: It happened years ago, and it's a measure of the forgettable nature of the conflict that I no longer even recall what the dispute was about, but I definitely recall the resolution.
definitely.translationZh: 这件事发生在多年前，由于那场冲突实在微不足道，我已经完全不记得当初是为了什么而争执，但我对解决结果依然记忆犹新。
definitely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

definitely.sentenceEn: In the end, whether he ever owned the neighboring lot or was simply allowed to use it while he allegedly worked at the University, he definitely never owned the lot the tree grew on, which is the most important bit for the topic at hand.
definitely.translationZh: 最终，无论他是否曾拥有过邻近的地块，还是据称在大学工作期间被允许使用该地块，有一点是明确的：他从未拥有过那棵树所在的地块，而这才是当前话题中最重要的部分。

definitely.sentenceEn: A lot of headlines about moons are just ridiculous (you do not need to be particularly excited about a blue moon, it just looks like a regular full moon), but you should definitely roll out of bed to look at a blood moon if one is going to be visible in your region, even though they're just lunar eclipses and not evidence of bloody battles between the sky gods.
definitely.translationZh: 许多关于月亮的新闻标题都很荒谬（你不必对蓝月亮特别兴奋，它看起来就像普通的满月），但如果你的地区能看到血月，你绝对应该起床去看看，尽管它们只是月食，并非天空诸神之间血腥战斗的证据。

definitely.sentenceEn: What does the speaker definitely recall about the dispute mentioned as an example?
definitely.translationZh: 关于作为例子提到的那场争论，说话者肯定记得的是什么？

dementia.sentenceEn: The idea that dementia can be prevented is based on the comparison of the brain to a muscle.
dementia.translationZh: 认为痴呆可以预防的观点是基于将大脑比作肌肉的类比。

dementia.sentenceEn: Most older adults do not develop Alzheimer's disease or other forms of dementia .
dementia.translationZh: 大多数老年人不会患上阿尔茨海默氏病或其他形式的痴呆症。

dementia.sentenceEn: People with dementia have more serious problems, like feeling confused or getting lost in a familiar place.
dementia.translationZh: 痴呆症患者则面临更严重的问题，例如感到困惑或在熟悉的地方迷路。

dementia.sentenceEn: Dementia refers to the loss of cognitive abilities, and one of its most common forms is Alzheimer's disease(阿尔茨海默氏病).
dementia.translationZh: 痴呆症指的是认知能力的丧失，其最常见的形式之一是阿尔茨海默氏病。

dementia.sentenceEn: It is hard to determine whether people who are free from dementia tend to have more social activities, or more social activities keep people away from dementia .
dementia.translationZh: 很难确定是没有患痴呆症的人往往会有更多的社交活动，还是更多的社交活动能让人们远离痴呆症。

dementia.sentenceEn: Can Learning a Foreign Language Prevent Dementia ?
dementia.translationZh: 学习外语能预防痴呆症吗？

deprive.sentenceEn: At the same time, when a system no longer provides opportunities for the majority to participate in wealth building, it not only robs those who are excluded from opportunities, but also deprives them of their dignity.
deprive.translationZh: 同时，当一个体制不再为大多数人提供参与财富积累的机会时，它不仅剥夺了那些被排除在外的人的机会，也剥夺了他们的尊严。

deprive.sentenceEn: Risk-free activities deprive kids of the opportunity to test themselves and overcome their fears.
deprive.translationZh: 完全无风险的活动会剥夺孩子们考验自己、战胜恐惧的机会。
deprive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

deprive.sentenceEn: So in the example of housing, if we value relationships, sharing a home isn't depriving ourselves of space, but giving us an opportunity to spend more time with our loved ones.
deprive.translationZh: 所以拿住房来说，如果我们重视人际关系，那么与人合住并非是剥夺自己的空间，而是给了我们更多时间与所爱之人相处的机会。
deprive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第3句

deprive.sentenceEn: Young people are being deprived of the thing they need most—perspective, to know why their parents behave so peculiarly and why their grandparents say the things they do.
deprive.translationZh: 年轻人被剥夺了他们最需要的东西——洞察力，无法理解为什么父母的行为如此特别，为什么祖父母会说那些话。
deprive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

deprive.sentenceEn: The best results were among younger children and in more deprived areas.
deprive.translationZh: 最显著的成效出现在低龄儿童群体和更贫困的地区。
deprive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

deprive.sentenceEn: They will be deprived of what their predecessors were proud of about themselves.
deprive.translationZh: 他们将失去前辈们曾引以为傲的特质。

deteriorate.sentenceEn: But deteriorating policies such as heavily taxing technology companies or real estate developers are not likely to shift the balance.
deteriorate.translationZh: 但是，像对科技公司或房地产开发商征收重税这类糟糕的政策不太可能改变这种平衡。

deteriorate.sentenceEn: Every single measure of material and environmental welfare in America, Europe, Asia, Africa and the world as a whole has improved rather than deteriorated .
deteriorate.translationZh: 无论是美洲、欧洲、亚洲、非洲，还是全球整体，其物质与环境福祉的各项指标均呈现改善而非恶化的趋势。
deteriorate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

deteriorate.sentenceEn: The dust and toxic chemicals you bring into your house via your shoes can deteriorate the air quality in your home.
deteriorate.translationZh: 你通过鞋子带入家中的灰尘和有毒化学物质会降低室内空气质量。
deteriorate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

deteriorate.sentenceEn: "The health of ecosystems on which we and all other species depend is deteriorating more rapidly than ever," Robert Watson said.
deteriorate.translationZh: 罗伯特·沃森表示：“我们及所有其他物种赖以生存的生态系统健康状况正以前所未有的速度恶化。”
deteriorate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

deteriorate.sentenceEn: There could be a biological explanation for this, as there's evidence that the brain's ability to make subtle distinctions between different chords, rhythms and melodies deteriorates with age.

document.sentenceEn: As to why he loved it so, the earliest documented account of this story is an anonymously written front page article in the Athens Weekly Banner published on August 12, 1890.
document.translationZh: 至于他为何如此喜爱它，这个故事最早的文字记载是1890年8月12日《雅典每周旗帜报》上一篇匿名撰写的头版文章。

document.sentenceEn: Imagine you're an alien sent to Earth to document the behaviour of the mammals inhabiting the planet.
document.translationZh: 想象一下，你是一名被派往地球的外星人，任务是记录这个星球上哺乳动物的行为。

document.sentenceEn: Companies should stipulate that they will never ask for passwords, be consistent, document decisions, consider the source used and be aware that other laws may apply.
document.translationZh: 公司应当明确规定：绝不能索要密码，要保持一致性，记录决策过程，考量信息来源，并且意识到可能适用其他法律。
document.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

document.sentenceEn: Sandy Cohen, owner of a graphic print production business, created the Quote Board to document the bizarre phrases people say when under strict deadlines.
document.translationZh: 桑迪·科恩是一家图文印刷制作公司的老板，他创建了一个“语录板”，用来记录人们在紧迫的截止日期压力下说出的各种离奇话语。

document.sentenceEn: For example, in Massachusetts, the healthcare professions require continuing education credits, which are carefully evidenced and documented .
document.translationZh: 例如，在马萨诸塞州，医疗保健行业要求从业人员获得继续教育学分，这些学分需经过仔细的证明和记录。

document.sentenceEn: Documents must be printed out and filed within one minute.
document.translationZh: 打印文件并归档，这些事情要在一分钟内完成。

dramatic.sentenceEn: This was a dramatic jump from 1989, where it stood at 15.8%.
dramatic.translationZh: 相比1989年15.8%的占比，这一数字出现了显著跃升。

dramatic.sentenceEn: A collection of dramatic videos and photos quickly spread across social media, showing the horrifying destruction, and attracting emotional responses from people all over the world.
dramatic.translationZh: 一系列触目惊心的视频和照片迅速在社交媒体上传播，展现了这场可怕的破坏，引发了世界各地人们的情感共鸣。

dramatic.sentenceEn: However, it's not just factories that are seeing losses—software and information technology are also having a dramatic impact on jobs most people think are secure from the forces of a rapidly-changing economy.
dramatic.translationZh: 然而，并非只有工厂出现岗位流失——软件和信息技术也正对那些多数人认为能在快速变化的经济浪潮中安然无恙的工作产生巨大冲击。
dramatic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

dramatic.sentenceEn: If represented graphically, the curve for all these changes looks rather like that well-known hockey stick: with little change over millennia(数千年) and a dramatic upswing over the past decades.
dramatic.translationZh: 如果以图形方式呈现，所有这些变化的曲线看起来都很像那根著名的'曲棍球杆'：数千年间几乎没有变化，而在过去几十年里却出现了急剧上升。

dramatic.sentenceEn: The deterioration of the ecological system is accelerating because of the dramatic increase of human production and consumption.
dramatic.translationZh: 由于人类生产和消费的急剧增长，生态系统的恶化正在加速。

dramatic.sentenceEn: It has experienced dramatic changes in recent years.
dramatic.translationZh: 近年来，它经历了巨大的变化。

database.sentenceEn: In addition, many libraries present classes and discussion programs, and some even provide online continuing education courses such as the Universal Class database .
database.translationZh: 此外，许多图书馆还提供课程和讨论项目，有些甚至提供在线继续教育课程，如环球课堂数据库。

database.sentenceEn: According to the FAO's statistical database , total direct greenhouse gas emissions from U.S. livestock have declined by 11.3 percent since 1961, while production of livestock meat has more than doubled.
database.translationZh: 根据联合国粮农组织的统计数据库，自1961年以来，美国畜牧业的直接温室气体排放总量下降了11.3%，而畜禽肉类产量却增长了一倍以上。

database.sentenceEn: Airlines inventory their mishandled baggage, and many use a database to match the contents with owners' descriptions.
database.translationZh: 航空公司会对处理不当的行李进行清点，许多公司还会使用数据库将行李内物品与失主的描述进行匹配。
database.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

database.sentenceEn: Algorithms that were right 95% of the time when they were dealing with a 13,000-image database , for example, were accurate about 70% of the time when confronted with 1 million images.
database.translationZh: 例如，在处理包含13,000张图像的数据库时准确率为95%的算法，在面对100万张图像时准确率仅为70%左右。
database.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

database.sentenceEn: As the databases grew, machine accuracy dipped across the board.
database.translationZh: 随着数据库规模的扩大，机器的准确率全面下降。
database.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

database.sentenceEn: It decreases as the database size increases.
database.translationZh: 随着数据库规模的增大，其准确性会下降。

degradation.sentenceEn: These included measures to reduce air pollution; to control the damage to marine ecosystems, which can have a huge effect on fish stocks on which hundreds of millions of people depend; and to curb the degradation of land where modern agricultural methods were pursued without regard to the longer-term consequences.
degradation.translationZh: 这些措施包括减少空气污染；控制对海洋生态系统的破坏——这可能对亿万人口赖以生存的鱼类资源产生巨大影响；以及遏制土地退化，这种退化源于不顾长远后果而推行现代农业方法的行为。
degradation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

degradation.sentenceEn: Degradation of the world's natural resources by humans is rapidly outpacing the planet's ability to absorb the damage, a recent UN environmental study has found.
degradation.translationZh: 联合国近期的一项环境研究发现，人类对世界自然资源的破坏速度正迅速超过地球吸收这些损害的能力。
degradation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

degradation.sentenceEn: Water resources are under increasing threat from population growth, climate change, rapid urbanization, rising levels of consumption, and the degradation of lands that previously provided a natural replenishment(补充) of water resources.
degradation.translationZh: 水资源正日益受到人口增长、气候变化、快速城市化、消费水平上升以及土地退化的威胁，而这些土地曾经为水资源提供自然补充。
degradation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

degradation.sentenceEn: "Plastic is incredibly resistant to degradation ," said McGeehan.
degradation.translationZh: 麦吉汉说：“塑料极难降解。”
degradation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

degradation.sentenceEn: Biodiversity loss, environmental degradation , and severe impacts on ecosystem services have not only accompanied conventional farming systems but have often extended well beyond their field boundaries.
degradation.translationZh: 生物多样性减少、环境退化以及对生态系统服务的严重影响不仅伴随着传统农业体系，而且往往远远超出了其田间范围。
degradation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

degradation.sentenceEn: They cannot modernise farming without causing land degradation .
degradation.translationZh: 他们若要实现农业现代化，就必然会导致土地退化。

delivery.sentenceEn: "Robot food deliveries are the future," says Noel Sharkey.
delivery.translationZh: 诺尔·沙基表示：“机器人外卖配送代表了未来。”

delivery.sentenceEn: He talks enthusiastically about the Helsinki pop-up Take-In, a full-service restaurant where diners ordered dishes in from various delivery services.
delivery.translationZh: 他兴致勃勃地谈论着赫尔辛基的快闪餐厅 Take-In，这是一家提供全方位服务的餐厅，食客可以在店内通过各种外卖服务点餐。

delivery.sentenceEn: Invariably, over the next 10 years, jobs will go in conventional bricks-built restaurants, not least because automation will boost their rapidly growing rival: delivery .
delivery.translationZh: 在未来的十年里，传统实体餐厅的岗位必将逐步缩减，这在很大程度上是因为自动化将助力其飞速成长的竞争对手：外卖行业。

delivery.sentenceEn: Companies such as Domino and Just Eat have both experimented with robot and drone delivery , which is already legal in Reykjavik, Iceland.
delivery.translationZh: 达美乐（Domino's）和 Just Eat 等公司都已在尝试机器人和无人机配送，这种配送方式在冰岛的雷克雅未克已经合法化。

delivery.sentenceEn: Streets were full of new numbers of cars in addition to delivery wagons, bustling crowds, bicycles, horse-drawn carriages, and street cars.
delivery.translationZh: 街道上除了送货马车、熙熙攘攘的人群、自行车、马车和有轨电车外，还到处都是新增的汽车。

delivery.sentenceEn: Over the coming decade, many jobs in traditional restaurants will disappear due to robot delivery .
delivery.translationZh: 未来十年，由于机器人送餐的普及，传统餐厅的许多岗位将会消失。

deplete.sentenceEn: By the 1880s, it was noticed that the bird population had become seriously depleted .
deplete.translationZh: 到19世纪80年代，人们注意到旅鸽的数量已严重减少。
deplete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

deplete.sentenceEn: It depletes their energy, culminating in disproportionate levels of damaging sentiment.
deplete.translationZh: 这会耗尽他们的精力，最终导致产生过度的不良情绪。
deplete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

deplete.sentenceEn: No one disputes the costs in quality of life and depleted health budgets of an obese population, but the quest for solutions gets diverted by ideological arguments around responsibility and choice.
deplete.translationZh: 没有人会质疑肥胖人群在生活质量上的损失和医疗预算的消耗，但寻求解决方案的努力却被围绕责任与选择的意识形态争论所转移。
deplete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

deplete.sentenceEn: Still, having a manager nearby at least indicates there's an opportunity they'll be decent enough to look out for you when your energy and focus begin to deplete .
deplete.translationZh: 不过，身边有个经理至少意味着，当你精力不济、注意力开始下降时，他们或许会足够体贴地关照你。
deplete.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

deplete.sentenceEn: When meetings continue too long or don't engage employees, they deplete vitality.
deplete.translationZh: 当会议持续时间过长或无法让员工参与时，就会消耗活力。

deficit.sentenceEn: It's hard to make a compelling argument that the United States has a calorie deficit , given its high national rates of adult and child obesity.
